decisions.text: values on both sides of zero: room at both ends
one total, Net donations, stacked from its 5 parts
stacking order from the base: East, West, South, North, Central (the largest at the base, where it is read precisely; G7.31, D-26 (b))
each part in one colour and one place in every total: East (slot 1), West (slot 2), South (slot 3), North (slot 4), Central (slot 5) (G4.22)
one total: one stack, standing upright (07 §5.4), its parts named beside it: vertical stacked bars
5 values against 6 scale labels: whichever puts fewer numbers on the chart (G2.18): the values labelled directly, the value scale and its gridlines removed, the zero line kept as the baseline
value labels as a set, one magnitude and one number of decimals, the prefix and suffix on each: $34K, −$17K, $9K, $8K, −$4K (G6.16, G7.4)
each value before its part's name beside the stack: the text grey does not read on the parts' colours at 4.5 : 1 inside them (G7.4, G6.5)
the unit's description on its own line above the plot: “net donations per region”; the labels carry its prefix, suffix and magnitude
each part named beside the stack, level with the middle of its segment, top to bottom as stacked: North, South, East, West, Central (their values before them) (G5.4, D-31 (c))
